hero.title: Explore Sacred Texts
hero.subtitle: Search across Quran and Bible with AI. Discover connections, compare perspectives, find answers.

sections.builtForDepth: Built for Depth, Not Just Speed

semantic.title: Understands What You Mean
semantic.description: Describe a concept or explore an idea in your own words. The AI grasps meaning and context — surfacing relevant passages even when you don't know the exact terms to search for.

parallel.title: Every Scripture at Once
parallel.description: Quran, Old Testament, New Testament, and Apocrypha — all 43,055 verses searched simultaneously so no perspective goes unheard.

traceable.title: Traceable to the Source
traceable.description: Every insight is backed by exact verse references. Nothing is claimed without a source you can look up and verify yourself.

ask.label: Ask
ask.detail: Any theological concept, moral question, or scriptural topic — in your own words.

enrich.label: Enrich
enrich.detail: The AI expands your question with related concepts and terminology across traditions.

discover.label: Discover
discover.detail: 43,055 verses across Quran and Bible are scanned simultaneously for the most relevant passages.

understand.label: Understand
understand.detail: 5 specialist agents each contribute their scripture's voice, then a synthesis brings them together.

agents.title: Multi-Agent Analysis
agents.subtitle: Each question is analyzed by 5 specialized AI agents in parallel — 4 scripture experts and 1 comparative theologian — producing a comprehensive essay with full citations.

quran.name: Quran Agent
quran.description: Surfaces the most relevant verses with precise Surah and Ayah citations — presenting the Quran's own words on any topic.

oldTestament.name: Old Testament Agent
oldTestament.description: Searches Genesis through Malachi to find relevant passages with exact chapter and verse references — the scripture in its own voice.

newTestament.name: New Testament Agent
newTestament.description: Retrieves relevant passages from the Gospels, Letters, and Revelation with precise citations — the text as it was written.

apocrypha.name: Apocrypha Agent
apocrypha.description: Explores books like Wisdom, Sirach, and Maccabees — scriptures cherished across Christian traditions, cited with full references.

synthesis.name: Synthesis Agent
synthesis.description: Synthesizes all 4 perspectives into a unified comparative essay — identifying common themes, key differences, and cross-scripture connections with full citation traceability.

cta.title: Ready to explore sacred texts?
cta.description: Search 43,055 verses across the Quran and Bible with AI-powered insight.

Footer.description: Maximum-accuracy RAG search for sacred texts with AI-powered comparative analysis.
